title: Face-Word Current Closure Test
source: BT1850 face words on the MCXCII Reye-K12 horizon completion
current_rule: for oriented face (a,b,c), currents are (b-a, c-b, a-c) mod 12
interpretation: All 44 face words are flat in Z/12Z. The only nonordinary flats are exactly the 12 triangles containing one distance-6 antipodal edge, so the six genus-hole parity symbols should absorb antipodal sheet data rather than ordinary curvature.
boundary: Current closure is a finite Z/12Z incidence result, not an optical phase-noise measurement.
